pause.name: the repaints ran inside the pause loop (pause kind 1, after the pause entry's render)
the pause entry's picture is the same with and without the repaints
a repaint draws the pause entry's picture draw for draw (scene and HUD)
a repaint with a 9:16 HUD layout: the same scene, the HUD moved
a repaint with the HUD as before draws the pause entry's picture again
160 passes after the pause: every picture draw for draw the same with and without the repaints
the game's memory outside the stack is the same after them (but the object draw count 0x6a5c84)
the repaints restored every aging draw and drew no kart part off its body (render-replay.js stats)

finish.name: the finish screen (Ctrl+F+I): phase 3, the special text idle 40 passes into it
notice(true) shows "pauze" (the special text runs), notice(false) takes it off (idle again)
the held picture: the notice's draws on top of the HUD, then the same scene with a 9:16 HUD
every pass after the hold until the race ends: draw for draw the same with and without it
race.ini at the end the same
the game's globals at the end the same (but the object draw count 0x6a5c84); bytes differ only in the heap

gameover.name: Tijdrace game over (phase 6): "tijd is om!" runs as the special text, so no "pauze" over it
